 Thinking about voting early? Want to know what the weather will be like at the polls on Election Day?
 The KAKE First Alert Weather team made a forecast for every county in KAKEland. It covers each day that early voting is open, plus Election Day.
 Pick your county below. You will see a forecast for each day polls are open there. Each one shows the temperature, sky and wind from when polls open to when they close.
 Pick your county 
 Choose a county… 
 Forecast graphics by KAKE First Alert Weather from National Weather Service hourly forecast data, made Wed., Oct. 28. Voting hours are from the Kansas Secretary of State’s advance voting list. Hours can change, so check with your county election office before you go.
 Each forecast also lists where you can vote early and the hours for each location.
 On Election Day, Tuesday, Nov. 3, polls are open from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m.
 Hours can change. Check with your county election office before you go.
